json.message: requests.$M() call has no timeout= argument: it can hang forever if the remote service stalls
json.note: By default `requests` waits indefinitely for a response, so a slow or dead upstream service blocks the worker thread forever. Always pass an explicit `timeout=` (e.g. `timeout=10`) to every requests call.
json.reason: The fix adds the missing `timeout=` argument to a `requests` HTTP call — a syntactically detectable API misuse that recurs anywhere requests is used.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  pattern: requests.$M($$$ARGS)
  kind: call
  not:
    has:
      stopBy: end
      kind: keyword_argument
      pattern: timeout=$_
constraints:
  M:
    regex: "^(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options|request)$"
json.title: HTTP request without a timeout
